stages.name: seedling
stages.needs: Shallow roots dry out fast; keep the top soil moist.

stages.name: vegetative
stages.needs: Building leaves and stems; steady watering gives strong plants.

stages.name: flowering/fruit set
stages.needs: Water stress now drops flowers and causes blossom-end rot, so do not let it dry.

stages.name: ripening
stages.needs: Slightly drier soil improves fruit quality, but avoid big swings that crack fruit.

stages.name: seedling
stages.needs: Keep the top soil moist for young roots.

stages.name: vegetative
stages.needs: Steady moisture builds the plant frame.

stages.name: flowering/fruiting
stages.needs: Sensitive to dry spells; flowers drop under stress.

stages.name: vegetative
stages.needs: Roots go deep; water less often but deeply.

stages.name: tasseling/silking
stages.needs: Most critical stage; stress here cuts grain yield sharply.

stages.name: grain fill
stages.needs: Keep moisture steady until grains fill.

stages.name: growing
stages.needs: Shallow roots and tender leaves; needs frequent light watering.
